content.title: Individual Support
content.paragraph: Support one life, change one future. Direct impact, real change, real people.

content.heading: What is Individual Support?
paragraphs: Individual Support is a transparent way of helping a specific child, woman, family, or animal directly. Your contribution goes toward real people in need through structured programs like education, food, healthcare, empowerment, and emergency support.

items.title: Child Education
items.desc: Support school fees, kits, books & learning resources.

items.title: Nutrition Support
items.desc: Provide meals and essential food support to needy families.

items.title: Women Support
items.desc: Empower women with skills, hygiene and livelihood support.

items.title: Medical Help
items.desc: Assist in treatment, medicines and healthcare needs.

items.title: Animal Care
items.desc: Support rescue, feeding and treatment of animals.

items.title: Emergency Help
items.desc: Help families in crisis situations and urgent needs.

steps.title: 1. Choose support category
steps.desc: Select the area you want to support — education, nutrition, healthcare, or any cause close to your heart.

steps.title: 2. Make contribution
steps.desc: Complete your secure donation online via UPI, card, or net banking. Every contribution counts.

steps.title: 3. We assign real beneficiary
steps.desc: We identify and assign a verified beneficiary who needs support in your chosen category.

steps.title: 4. Support is delivered on ground
steps.desc: Your contribution is delivered directly to the beneficiary through our field programs.

steps.title: 5. You receive updates/report
steps.desc: We share updates, photos, and impact reports so you can see the change you made.

content.heading: Be Someone's Hope Today
content.paragraph: Join us in creating real change, one life at a time.
